scope: All 61 previously source-less rows in Tencent, ByteDance, iFlytek, MiniMax and StepFun, plus named pending newer rows. Existing verified audit additions were not redone.
method: Primary issuer documents, official repository News, issuer-authored research reports, and issuer-authored announcement pages. App launch, report publication, API release and open-weight release are separate stages. Unretrievable issuer pages or only secondary dates remain unverified.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 V1.0
findings.evidence: Issuer education news published 2023-05-07 explicitly says Spark arrived on May 6; later issuer speech labels the original May 6 release V1.0.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 V2.0
findings.evidence: Issuer article published 2023-08-15 explicitly says V2.0 was formally launched on August 15.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 V3.0
findings.evidence: Issuer smart-home article dated 2023-11-15 explicitly says V3.0 was formally released on October 24.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 V3.5
findings.evidence: Issuer article published 2024-01-31 explicitly identifies January 30 as the V3.5 upgrade launch.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 4.0
findings.evidence: Issuer article published 2024-06-28 explicitly says Spark V4.0 and applications were released in Beijing on June 27.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 4.0 Turbo
findings.evidence: Issuer article dated 2024-10-24 explicitly reports the October 24 launch of Spark 4.0 Turbo.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 X1
findings.evidence: Issuer 2025 Osaka Expo article explicitly dates the debut of the X1 deep-reasoning model to January 15, 2025.

findings.name: 星火 X1 升级版
findings.evidence: Issuer article dated 2025-04-30 explicitly says X1 received its latest upgrade on April 20.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 X1.5
findings.evidence: Issuer article dated 2025-11-07 explicitly dates the launch of the X1.5 deep-reasoning model to November 6.

findings.name: 星火开源-13B
findings.evidence: Issuer co-founded lab explicitly states Spark open-source 13B was formally released on 2024-01-30; not inferred from V3.5 family date.

findings.name: 讯飞星火 X2
findings.evidence: Official API page says X2 is available and displays update date 2026-02-09. Widely reported public announcement 2026-02-11 has an identified official WeChat URL, but that primary page could not be retrieved. A documentation update is not proof of first release. Keep February 11 as pending public-announcement claim; do not change it to February 9.

findings.name: 星火 X2-VL
findings.evidence: Issuer 2026 semiannual report directly confirms release in June 2026, but not June 11. Existing Wuxi government-hosted article says June 11; exact day still lacks retrieved issuer confirmation.

findings.name: Spark Lite
findings.evidence: Official catalog confirms identity and current availability; date shown is an update date. Historical May 22, 2024 coverage concerns a free-API pricing change rather than proving first release. No exact first-release date established.

findings.name: Spark Mini
findings.evidence: Official catalog confirms this fine-tuning base model. Its displayed 2024-10-22 update date does not establish first release; no dated issuer launch announcement located.

findings.name: abab6
findings.evidence: Found original MiniMax Open Platform announcement URL, but primary WeChat content was not retrievable. Issuer-branded Juejin profile repeats the announcement without exact day; investor repost and contemporary reporting support 2024-01-16. Exact day remains unverified under issuer-source-only standard.

findings.name: abab6.5
findings.evidence: Official article dated 2024-04-17 introduces abab6.5 and abab6.5s as two separate models; exact original abab6.5 date supported.

findings.name: MiniMax-M1
findings.evidence: Chinese official API release log explicitly places MiniMax-M1 formal release on 2025-06-16; both Chinese and English issuer launch articles also carry June 16. June 19 Agent article says two days ago, an imprecise conflicting retrospective phrase; use explicit model log/date for announcement/API stage, not an inferred weight-publication date.

findings.name: video-01 (abab-video-1)
findings.evidence: Official Video-01 launch article is dated 2024-08-31 and explicitly announces the company’s first video model.

findings.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview
findings.evidence: Current official model catalog and Code/Agent interfaces confirm availability, but no dated issuer launch announcement or model-release-log entry was found. Do not substitute crawl, commit, or interface update dates.

findings.name: MiniMax-M2.1-highspeed
findings.evidence: Chinese official release log explicitly names MiniMax-M2.1 / M2.1-highspeed together under 2025-12-22. This is variant-specific evidence rather than inheritance from family launch.

findings.name: MiniMax-M2.5-highspeed
findings.evidence: Official release log explicitly names M2.5 and M2.5-highspeed but only dates them to February 2026. February 12 launch blog announces M2.5-Lightning; exact alias equivalence to highspeed and endpoint first day were not directly established, so do not silently assign family day.

findings.name: Speech-2.6-hd
findings.evidence: Chinese official release log dates MiniMax-Speech-2.6 to 2025-10-29 and explicitly calls it a new HD speech model. Current official catalog identifies the HD endpoint as speech-2.6-hd; supports this variant specifically. Blog published October 30 is a later announcement page.

findings.name: Speech-2.6-turbo
findings.evidence: Current official catalog confirms speech-2.6-turbo. Chinese October 29 release-log entry explicitly describes HD; English family log and October 30 launch article do not explicitly date Turbo. Keep date unknown rather than borrowing HD/family day.

findings.name: Speech-2.8-hd
findings.evidence: Official catalog confirms this endpoint; January 23, 2026 release log and launch article date the Speech 2.8 family but do not explicitly identify launch-day HD/Turbo variants. Exact variant first day not established.

findings.name: Speech-2.8-turbo
findings.evidence: Official catalog confirms this endpoint; January 23, 2026 release log and launch article date the Speech 2.8 family but do not explicitly identify launch-day HD/Turbo variants. Exact variant first day not established.

final_additions.name: abab6.5s
final_additions.evidence: Issuer article dated April17 explicitly names both abab6.5 and abab6.5s; add omitted parallel efficient variant.
